title: artifacts/summary.json of a verification run
description: The counters verify-brief.yml writes after a run and gates on. Each verify-*.yml emits the fields it owns (others null) so a combined brief can be rebuilt from several runs by taking, per field, the non-null value. Gate rules: counterexamples, dafny, tla, lean == failure, kani == failure, go_vet, go_crashers always fail; ts_errors_changed and bare_high_risk fail when strict is true, otherwise warn; unverified and diff_differs warn.

changed_public.description: Changed public Python functions in non-test files (contract census).

contracted.description: Of those, functions carrying a contract (icontract, deal, PEP 316 docstring, trailing assert).

bare_high_risk.description: Changed public functions on high-risk paths with no contract. Blocks when strict.

counterexamples.description: CrossHair counterexamples: a stated contract is false. Always blocks.

unverified.description: Contracts CrossHair reported as Not confirmed (budget or opaque call). Advisory; blocks on high-risk paths at Standard.

diff_differs.description: crosshair diffbehavior: refactored functions that differ from base on some input (refactor label only). Advisory.

go_vet.description: go vet exit code on changed packages; non-zero blocks.

go_crashers.description: New files under testdata/fuzz after the per-PR fuzz. Any blocks.

ts_errors_changed.description: tsc errors under the strictest flags in files this PR changed. Blocks when strict.

dafny.description: dafny verify exit code; non-zero blocks.

tla.description: TLC exit code over specs with a sibling .cfg; non-zero blocks.

kani.description: Kani outcome when a kani::proof exists; failure blocks.

gobra.description: Gobra exit code (#129, not in the brief); non-zero blocks at Standard.

alloy.description: Alloy analyzer exit code (#130); an instance of a counterexample assertion blocks.

mutation_score.description: Killed mutants / total on mapped modules (#125, #126, #127); advisory until the threshold is set.

strict.description: STRICT_HIGH_RISK: uncontracted high-risk functions and TypeScript errors block instead of warn.

tool.description: Which verify-*.yml wrote this partial summary.
